_comment: Client defaults are the original studio reference. Change host, port, printerUrl, or displayName for another share. A non-empty printerUrl overrides host and port. Command-line -HostIp -Port -PrinterUrl -DisplayName and environment variables STUDIO_LAN_HOST, STUDIO_LAN_PORT, STUDIO_LAN_PRINTER_URL, STUDIO_LAN_DISPLAY override this file. Values with spaces belong in this file. The bat forwards command-line arguments across the admin prompt. 工作室参考地址可改，不必改脚本。
